clusters.name: Pants and Shorts

clusters.name: Skirts
clusters.description: Standalone lower-body garments with a waistband and a single skirt body rather than separate legs, including short and long skirts. Excludes dresses, pants and shorts.

clusters.name: Flats and Dress Shoes
clusters.description: Low-cut, closed-toe footwear with non-sneaker construction, including ballet flats, loafers, lace-up dress shoes and heeled pumps. Excludes sneakers, boots and open strappy sandals.

clusters.name: Bras and Bralettes
clusters.description: Bust-supporting undergarments with paired cups and a connecting chest band, typically with shoulder straps. Includes bras and bralettes, distinct from full shirts and dresses.
